v7-30.candidate: Judas learned that he had come against him deceitfully. He became afraid of him and would no longer see his face.
v7-30.close: Judas learned that he had come against him deceitfully. He became wary of him and would no longer see his face.

v7-17.display:
“They poured out the flesh of Thy holy ones and their blood around Jerusalem,
and there was no one to bury them.”

v7-37.display:
“Thou didst choose this house for Thy name to be called upon it,
to be a house of prayer and petition for Thy people.

v7-38.display:
Exact vengeance upon this man and his army,
and let them fall by the sword.
Remember their insults,
and grant them no continuance.”

v7-41.display:
“When the king’s men spoke blasphemously,
Thine angel went out
and struck a hundred and eighty-five thousand among them.

v7-42.display:
In this way crush this army before us today.
Let the survivors know that he has spoken wickedly against Thy holy places,
and judge him according to his wickedness.”
